title: Data Protection Keys: Share Them Across Servers | Orchard Core
description:
Orchard Core protects authentication cookies, anti-forgery tokens and saved credentials with Data Protection keys. By default each tenant keeps its keys in a local folder, which breaks a load-balanced site because every server has different keys.

The Distributed Data Protection features keep the key ring of each tenant in Azure Blob Storage or in Redis, so every server reads the same keys.

In this video:
• Why the keys matter, and where they live by default
• The three places for the key ring
• Enabling a key store under Tools, Features
• Azure Blob Storage: settings, blob layout and a container per tenant
• Redis: settings, key names and persistence
• Checking the log and the store
